phase: stability check of the score-statistic ranking experiment across abstention budgets

null_score.justification: cls_start + cls_end; high = the no-answer ([CLS]) score dominates

best_answer_score.justification: best_start_logit + best_end_logit; high = a strong answer span exists, so low values abstain

margin.justification: null_score - best_answer_score (definition preserved); high = null dominates the best span

method.only_variable_changed_vs_K47: the abstention budget K (95 instead of 47)

chance_reference.note: explicit random reference for the fixed budget, not a fitted baseline

classification_rule_pre_specified.INSUFFICIENT_DIFFERENCE: otherwise (mixed/inconsistent movement that crosses none of the above)

stability_rule_pre_specified.inputs: classification agreement across the 8 non-null (model, statistic) pairs + preservation of the per-model ordering of statistics by true abstention
stability_rule_pre_specified.STABLE: classification agreement == 8/8 AND the true-abstention ordering of the five statistics is preserved for BOTH checkpoints
stability_rule_pre_specified.PARTIALLY_STABLE: classification agreement in 5..7 of 8, OR ordering preserved for exactly one checkpoint
stability_rule_pre_specified.UNSTABLE: classification agreement <= 4 of 8, OR ordering preserved for neither checkpoint

interpretation_boundary: No inference, no model loading, no training, no database, no retrieval was used.
K=95 was fixed before evaluation and was neither searched nor tuned; no threshold is used.
The K=47 abstention sets were reconstructed only to measure set composition and were verified against the recorded K=47 artifact.
Classifications are descriptive comparisons to null_score under the pre-specified rule; no statistic is declared universally superior.
No causal or architectural claim (H-A..H-E) is made.
